articles.title: Sending a ship to Strait of Hormuz would test 'small, stretched' Australian navy
articles.summary: Australia has decided against deploying a warship to the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, with the primary reason cited as the absence of a direct request from the United States. This decision underscores Australia's independent foreign policy approach amidst ongoing maritime security concerns in a critical global shipping lane.
